ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MitiMiti uses the microphone only while you dictate an expense, to type it for you.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MitiMiti turns what you dictate into text to log the expense, with Apple's speech recognition. The audio isn't sent to MitiMiti.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: MitiMiti uses the camera to photograph a receipt and read the total. The photo is not kept.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MitiMiti opens your photos so you can pick a receipt and read the total. The photo is not kept.
